name: NewTool

sources.title: NewTool - Submit (renders a login wall: email/password, Google and GitHub OAuth)
NewTool - Pricing (free badge-gated plan, Pro $9.9 one-time, Sponsor $19.9/mo)

conditions: Free plan ($0): 'Get 1 dofollow link' but 'Badge verification required - keep badge permanently, check regularly & unpublish if removed'

Pro ($9.9 one-time): 'list right now', permanent link with NO backlink required, >=3 dofollow links, featured homepage/category placement; Sponsor ($19.9/mo): site-wide top-banner placement (max 3 sponsor slots)
requirements: Account is mandatory: /submit renders a login wall - email/password plus 'Login with Google' and 'Login with GitHub'; register at /auth/register
For the free tier: embed the NewTool badge on the submitted site and keep it permanently
Product details: name, URL, description, categories/tags (directory covers tools and startups, not only AI)
preparation: An account (email signup or Google/GitHub OAuth)
A permanent spot for their badge/backlink if using the free plan
Or $9.9 for the Pro one-time plan to skip the badge and the 30-day queue
workflow: Register/sign in at newtool.site (email, Google, or GitHub)
Open https://newtool.site/submit and complete the product form
Pick free (badge verification + up to 30-day review) or Pro $9.9 (immediate listing, no badge)
If free: place the NewTool badge on your site and keep it - they re-check and unpublish if removed
watchFor: Permanent monitored badge requirement on the free tier - the dofollow link is contingent on keeping theirs
30-day free review window vs 'list right now' on the $9.9 plan
Sponsor slots are capped at 3 and sold monthly - ignore unless site-wide placement is wanted
The whole flow sits behind auth - no anonymous submission
countsAsLive: The product has a public detail page on newtool.site and appears under Latest Products/its category
unknowns: Whether the '1 dofollow link' on free points to the submitted URL on the detail page
Any rejection criteria beyond badge verification
